title: metadata: the remaining PutOptions.actor producers that give a label or drop the user (plugin-security 'system', metadata-fs 'fs', the runtime dispatcher's PUT); one family card after #23068
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): the closing card of one family. In each case a producer gives `PutOptions.actor` (or its sibling actor fields) something other than "the acting user's id, or `null`", the contract in `packages/metadata-core/src/types.ts` (#4556). #23068 (PR #23085) fixes the migrate-stored pass and its three doors. This card holds every remaining position in the family, with one pin per position.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-steve` · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` · 2026-10-12T18:56Z, at PR #23085's ACCEPT. It comes from #23068's dev (os-dev-report 6130617962, out-of-scope findings 1 to 3). Per the family rule, they share one card, not three single-point ones. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## Positions (read from code; none measured through a live door yet)
1. **`'system'` sentinel, plugin-security:** `reconcilePermissionSetProjection` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts`, called from the security plugin's reconcile) and `backfillRowOnlyPositions` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-environment-backfill.ts`) call `saveMetaItem` with `actor: 'system'`. That is the sentinel #4556 retired, and it lands in `recorded_by`, `created_by` and `updated_by`. **Both modules are deleted by #22975's 7a and 7b**, which are built ahead and wait on #15204 stage 8. This position closes when they land, and the pin is that no `'system'` literal reaches `PutOptions.actor` afterwards.
2. **`'fs'` default, metadata-fs:** `MetadataPlugin` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`) attaches `FileSystemRepository` without an `fsActor`. `FileSystemRepository` (`packages/metadata-fs/src/repository.ts`) then defaults it to `'fs'` in its constructor and in every `authoredBy` / event-actor fallback. `MetadataEventSchema.actor`'s describe says "Never a sentinel string", and since PR #23085 `MetadataItemSchema.authoredBy`'s says the same.
3. **Under-recorded user, the runtime dispatcher:** `HttpDispatcher`'s `PUT /metadata/:type/:name` branch (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`, `saveMetaItem` with `writeFace 'meta-dispatch'`) passes no actor, although `executionContext.userId` is in hand. So a signed-in user's save records `null`. The REST twin passes the user id through `resolveMetaWriteActor` (#7749, #7941).

## Wanted
- Each position passes the acting user's id, or `null`, never a label, and records the user when there is one.
- Position 1 is satisfied by #22975's deletions. Verify it at their landing.
- Pins: one per position. Plus a repo-wide check that no string literal reaches `PutOptions.actor`, at least as a test over the known producers. A new gate needs the maintainer's naming, so a pin is enough.

## Not here
Rows that past passes already wrote keep their labels (`recorded_by`, `updated_by`). A journal cleanup beside `recorded-by-sentinel` waits for evidence that a real deployment holds such rows: a direct query, or the dangling-reference audit.

Dedupe: #4556 (closed; the repository side) and #23068 (the migrate-stored pass). No open card names these positions.
